pr_title: Reuse a finished lens task for the same revision

comments.comment: selectionKey names the lens, version, head, band and route but not the rendered instructions, so a review after a standards edit attaches to the finished task and returns the answer to the old text.
comments.failureScenario: A maintainer reviews head H and the security lens runs under the standards as they stand. They edit AGENTS.md to add a rule and review H again: the key `security v3 H careful route` is unchanged, runLens finds the finished task, and returns its findings without asking the model, so the new rule is never applied to H and the review passes on stale instructions.
